criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Add To Playlist
categories.definition: User wants to add a specific track, album, or artist to a specified playlist.

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: User wants to play music, which may include specific songs, artists, albums, genres, or general requests, often specifying a platform.

categories.name: Rate Item
categories.definition: User wants to assign a rating or score to a specific book, album, textbook, essay, or other media item.

categories.name: Book Restaurant
categories.definition: User wants to make a reservation at a restaurant, pub, or cafe, often specifying location, time, or party size.

categories.name: Get Weather
categories.definition: User wants to know the weather forecast or specific weather conditions for a location and time.

categories.name: Find Movie Showtimes
categories.definition: User wants to find movie schedules, showtimes, or theaters playing a specific movie.

categories.name: Find Media
categories.definition: User wants to locate, search for, or view details about a specific creative work such as a book, novel, video game, TV show, or image.
